messages:
alex: :rotating_light: Heads up — we're seeing a spike of GPU attach failures in gcp-sao1. Lots of nodes stuck in IN_PROVISIONING and attach errors mentioning KMS timeouts and upstream routing errors. Pager spamming.

infra-bot: Alert: [GPU-PROV-ATTACH] 34 failing attaches in gcp-sao1. p95 attach latency 00:03:12, error rate 27%.

maya: Investigating now. I can see a BGP flap on the provider interconnect side to the São Paulo fabric. Peering remains up but routes are oscillating, causing control plane connections to intermittently drop.

josh: Confirmed on our side — kubelet logs show TLS handshake failures to the provisioner and also KMS client errors: 
```
Error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
kms: timeout connecting to kms.googleapis.com:443
```

emma: KMS decryption failures explain model key load errors. If nodes can't reach KMS, they fail to mount encrypted volumes. We should enable local KEK fallback for affected pools while routing stabilizes.

ricardo: Moving inference traffic cross-region will increase egress spend. Estimate: ~18–22% uplift if we shift 100% of sa0 traffic to us-central for the next 6 hours. We should do partial shift first.

alex: Agreed. Plan: 1) Canary 5% traffic to gcp-us-central 2) Start graceful evacuation of non-critical pools in gcp-sao1 (inference-pool-sao, batch-train-sao) 3) Enable local KMS fallback for evacuees.

josh: Kicking canary now. Command: 
```
# route 5% traffic from inference-sao -> inference-usc
redwoodctl route update inference --from-region gcp-sao1 --to-region gcp-us-central --percent 5
```

deploy-bot: Routing update submitted: inference -> gcp-us-central (5%). Change id: r-20260318-42.

josh: Starting drain for inference-pool-sao (graceful)
```
kubectl --context=sao1 cordon nodepool/inference-pool-sao
kubectl --context=sao1 drain nodepool/inference-pool-sao --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
```

maya: While draining, I'm swapping peering route preferences to prefer secondary path to reduce oscillation. Network team is also asking provider to suspend BGP flap convergence for that peer.

emma: To enable local fallback for affected agents, set env on nodepool controller: 
```
REDWOOD_KMS_FALLBACK=true
LOCAL_KEK_ID=local-sao-kek-01
KMS_FALLBACK_TTL=6h
```
This uses an on-node envelope key for short-term decrypts; keys are ephemeral and audit events emitted.

alex: Please ensure audit + rotate after restore. Also add a temporary alert for fallback enabled.

josh: Canary results: 5% shifted, initial check shows success. curl health check: 
```
> curl -sS -D - https://api.redwood.ai/health -H 'x-region: gcp-us-central'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-latency: 68ms
```
p95 increased ~20ms for canary but error rate zero.

ricardo: Noted — costs will scale linearly with traffic. I'll raise a temporary budget flag and notify finance for emergency egress spend approval.

maya: Evacuation progress: 12/40 nodes drained, 3 attach retries succeeded after route pref change. Still seeing intermittent KMS timeouts on the remaining nodes.

josh: Applied fallback config to inference-pool-sao and batch-train-sao. Rolling restart for controller to pick up env.

infra-bot: Notice: Fallback KMS mode enabled for nodepools: inference-pool-sao, batch-train-sao. Audit event emitted id=audit-20260318-77.

emma: Confirming model loads are progressing on evacuated nodes in us-central. Decryption using local KEK reported, keys rotated automatically after 2h per policy.

alex: Good. Next: increase routing to 30% if metrics stay stable for next 15m. Also prepare rollback plan to rehome back to sao1 when peering is stable.

josh: Bumped to 30%. Command: 
```
redwoodctl route update inference --percent 30
```

deploy-bot: Routing update applied: inference -> gcp-us-central (30%). Change id: r-20260318-43.

maya: Provider reports they applied a config change; BGP flaps reduced. We're seeing attach retries succeed much more consistently.

josh: Current metrics: attach fail rate down to 3%, p95 attach 42s -> 18s. Fallback KMS still on for 8 nodes.

alex: Let's hold at 30% for 20m then incrementally shift back. Ricardo — any objections on cost?

ricardo: Fine with temporary hold. Filing cost incident with finance.

infra-bot: All nodes in inference-pool-sao drained: 40 nodes evacuated.

emma: I'm starting the revoke/rotate of local KEKs on nodes that already rejoined gcp-sao1 and verified KMS connectivity. Will keep fallback flag enabled for the remainder until full restore.

alex: Thanks team. Post-incident actions: 1) postmortem 24h 2) add automated test that simulates BGP route oscillation & KMS fallback 3) revisit cross-region egress budget thresholds. Assign owners in the postmortem.

maya: I'll open the postmortem and link provider ticket.

josh: Closing loop — traffic back to 80% sa0 after 90m and fully restored by 3h from now. Will update thread when fully normalized.

infra-bot: Incident state: mitigation in progress.
